(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.water-stage svg');if(s.dataset.heater!=='on'||s.dataset.hotOpen!=='false'||s.dataset.coldOpen!=='false')throw Error('Incorrect reheat state');if(document.querySelector('#cycle-controls').hidden)throw Error('Missing thermostat controls');document.querySelector('#cycle-next').click();document.querySelector('#cycle-next').click();if(s.dataset.heater!=='off')throw Error('Thermostat did not switch off');document.querySelector('#cycle-next').click();document.querySelector('#cycle-next').click();if(s.dataset.heater!=='on')throw Error('Thermostat did not resume heating');return 'Thermostat reheat, shutoff, cooling and restart passed'})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.water-stage svg');if(s.dataset.heater!=='off'||s.dataset.hotOpen!=='false'||s.dataset.coldOpen!=='false')throw Error('Incorrect storage hygiene state');if(!document.querySelector('#cycle-controls').hidden)throw Error('Cycle controls still visible');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return 'Storage hygiene state passed'})()

(()=>{const x=document.getElementById('evap-loss'),n=document.querySelectorAll('[data-solute]').length;for(const [value,expected] of [[0,'1.00×'],[20,'1.25×'],[50,'2.00×']]){x.value=value;x.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));if(document.getElementById('concentration-ratio').textContent!==expected)throw Error('Mass-balance mismatch');if(document.querySelectorAll('[data-solute]').length!==n)throw Error('Solute mass changed');if(+document.getElementById('remaining-water').getAttribute('height')!==90*(1-value/100))throw Error('Water volume mismatch')}return 'Concentration model endpoints and constant solute amount passed'})()

(()=>{document.querySelector('[data-goto-phase="5"]').click();if(document.querySelector('.water-stage svg').dataset.phase!=='5')throw Error('Reheat shortcut failed');document.querySelector('[data-goto-phase="6"]').click();if(document.querySelector('.water-stage svg').dataset.phase!=='6')throw Error('Hygiene shortcut failed');return 'Diagram shortcuts passed'})()
